root_cause: Adam first-moment evaluation used a weighted sum instead of the upstream lerp form; second-moment multiply/add rounded separately instead of a fused final multiply-add. Small rounding differences changed the long optimizer trajectories. Independent libm-fmaf/NumPy modeling reproduces the reported discrepancy and the upstream results after the correction.
